paragraphs: NiCE sells Evidencentral, a cloud-based digital evidence management platform for public safety and justice agencies. The platform is meant to manage data from the moment an incident happens until a case is closed and prosecuted. For emergency communications centers that means incident recording and reconstruction, voice-to-text transcription, quality assurance and coaching, and PSAP performance reporting.

NiCE Inform automates incident reconstruction, evidence production, quality assurance and real-time performance metrics reporting. NiCE Investigate then brings evidence and associated information to investigators, patrol officers and criminal justice partners, with the stated aim of breaking down information silos. Further along the process, NiCE Justice and NiCE Defense help prosecution, defense and courts manage growing volumes of digital evidence. An Evidencentral Marketplace of technology vendors is designed to make it simpler and faster for emergency communications, law enforcement and criminal justice agencies to bring evidence together.

A customer story on the page comes from British Transport Police, attributed to its Senior Project Management for Digital Policing. The company describes the platform as powered by artificial intelligence and offers demos through the site.

quote.text: When lives are on the line, evidence is everything.
